decisions.reason: The safety shoe line moved from a mention in 2023 to a page of its own in 2024, which suggests it meets aspirations in the firm's core business, so search for other uses of its resources is not needed.

The comfort insole has stayed at the level of a mention, which signals modest performance, but it is a low-cost accessory that sits alongside the core safety shoes and that a large firm's slack can easily carry.
The supportive insole overlaps with the other insoles and has not gained visibility, yet it adds to the insole range at little cost, so the firm is likely to keep it while results remain uncertain.
The ergonomic safety shoe series has had its own page in both years, which shows lasting commitment and performance near aspiration in the core segment.
The firefighter and rescue boots gained visibility in 2024, which points to promising results in a specialised segment that fits the firm's established competence.
The moulded insole has been on the home page in both years and has a documented customer project (the FIT-DAY with ALBA Braunschweig), so it clearly exceeds aspirations and is a flagship product.
